title: Central Authority Prevention of Unfair Trade Practices

content.scenario: The Central Authority is required to prevent unfair trade practices and ensure that no person engages himself in unfair trade practices.
content.outcome: The Central Authority shall prevent unfair trade practices and ensure that no person engages himself in unfair trade practices.

user_queries: What is the role of the Central Authority in preventing unfair trade practices?
How does the Central Authority regulate unfair trade practices?
What are the consequences of engaging in unfair trade practices?
